title: WP-ARCH-D: fix acceptance.md status drift + shadow-calibrate ASSURE; badf-architecture VALIDATED -> SHADOWED
objective: Two things the operator's review surfaced. (1) Fix a documentation-state drift: badf-architecture's acceptance.md still said the capability is DESIGNED (line 3) and stays DESIGNED (line 48) while the registry, SKILL.md and the middle of the same doc say VALIDATED -- the claim-that-outlives-its-correction defect. (2) Shadow-calibrate the ASSURE substrate: run it retrospectively on real BADF architecture cases spanning the outcome space (COMPLIANT stdlib boundary; NONCOMPLIANT #57 PyYAML dependency drift; INDETERMINATE unobservable ADR), measure faithfulness, and advance VALIDATED -> SHADOWED (not ACTIVE).
business_value: The doc drift creates two conflicting normative statements inside one skill, which the next admission step would inherit; fixing it keeps the admission ladder honest. The shadow calibration converts 'the ASSURE controls pass on a synthetic example' into 'ASSURE detects a real violation, refuses to manufacture compliance, and handles the undecidable case' -- the SHADOWED evidence that must precede any advance to ACTIVE.
in_scope: skills/badf-architecture/references/acceptance.md: remove the two stale DESIGNED statements; mark SHADOWED met
advance badf-architecture VALIDATED -> SHADOWED (SKILL.md status, registry re-digest, acceptance ladder)
tests/test_badf_assure.py ShadowCalibrationTests + contract-test updates; own G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: advancing badf-architecture to APPROVED/ACTIVE (operator admission decision; explicitly deferred)
any new gate control or schema change (the shadow records exercise the existing controls 13-18)
acceptance_criteria: acceptance.md no longer says the capability is DESIGNED or stays DESIGNED; the contract test asserts it
the three shadow assurance records pass `assure` and span COMPLIANT/NONCOMPLIANT/INDETERMINATE
the drift case is a true UNAUTHORIZED_DRIFT / NONCONFORMANT with a MAJOR finding; the INDETERMINATE case does not serialise as a pass
badf-architecture registry status is SHADOWED with a real digest; the contract test asserts it
compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Docs + shadow records + status advance -- no gate control (empty gate diff). Fixes a real doc-drift defect the operator caught, and produces the SHADOWED calibration evidence. Advances badf-architecture VALIDATED -> SHADOWED; APPROVED/ACTIVE remain the operator's call. Reconciles WP-2026-0058.
